description: Prune block-1 pre-attention LayerNorm scales in nearest-neutral order

The most recent accepted result is attempt-0059 at 2,118 parameters/99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0118, whose block-1 pre-FF bias coordinate 6 scored 95.22% at 1,671 parameters. The closest remaining learned normalization scale to neutral is block-1 pre-attention coordinate 4 at 0.952516, distance 0.047484 from one. Hypothesis: multiplicative scaling has a different sensitivity structure from the now-bounded additive biases. The helper orders 15 eligible scales by current distance to one, fixes one per micro-trial, and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on first scored discard or error, no coordinate, 15 micro-trials, or 20 wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than block-0 scale coordinate 4 (distance 0.1433) because it is the minimum-neutral perturbation across remaining sparse normalization scales.
